items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: And in the rhythm section was William Houston and Louis Barbaran... And I went and got Kimball, Louis Barbaran, Alvin Alcorn, and myself with the full tunes.

ctx.x: That's all. Yeah. And who else?
Yeah, on the saxophone, we had Cottrell, Oscar Ruzon, Sam Lee. And in the rhythm section was William Houston and Louis Barbaran.
I'm trying to think who was playing bass with us then.
